sections.title: Why Terminal?
sections.description:
Why Terminal?

Terminal was founded by industry leaders to establish a new standard in yard execution that unifies critical yard functions within a full-stack, modern platform.

sections.title: The Yard Operating System™
sections.description:
The Yard Operating System™

Terminal’s comprehensive AI-native system, including its own SmartYard YMS, automates and optimizes every aspect of your yard operations into a single source of truth. Modular, configurable, integrated.

sections.title: The Agentic AI Yard
sections.description:
The Agentic AI Yard

Our AI agentic-enabled  system orchestrates yard operations in real time, using AI to make autonomous decisions, and continuously adapts to changing conditions, reducing delays, improving asset utilization, and providing a single coherent view of the entire yard.

sections.title: Terminal Computer Vision
sections.description:
Terminal Computer Vision

Turn a manual, fragmented logistics yard into an AI-driven system that automates operations, tracks assets, detects damage, and enhances security.

sections.title: Yard Security
sections.description: The yard is the most exposed surface of the supply chain. Terminal YOS™ mitigates security risks by binding security,  cargo fraud prevention, and custody with core yard management, delivering the industry's only closed-loop system of record for yard operations.

sections.title: YOS vs. YMS
sections.description:
YOS vs. YMS

See how our AI-native and vision-ready Yard Operating System goes beyond traditional Yard Management Systems to provide a complete, end-to-end solution.

sections.title: Top 10 Yard Problems
sections.description:

We know the yard. Explore the Top 10 challenges in yard logistics today and how Terminal provides specific, effective solutions for each one.

Terminal was designed to be a new industry standard in the yard to help unleash the performance and unlock the value and of your existing WMS and TMS systems.
